_why: Speech-to-text gets real words wrong in ways no automated check can catch, because the output is still valid English. These are CAPTION-ONLY fixes: the audio is never altered, and we never 'correct' what someone actually said - only what the model misheard. Verified by listening to the clip before adding an entry.
_rule: left = what the model wrote, right = what the person actually says. Case-insensitive, whole-phrase.
